svg.text: BOUGHT PARTS (estimates unless noted; confirm before order)
AC servo 750 W, 80 mm flange (Ø70 pilot, 4 x M6 on Ø90), Ø19 keyed shaft, 2.39 N·m rated / 7.16 peak, 3,000 rpm, with
SureServo2 SV2L-207B motor + SV2A-2075 drive + SVC2 cables (confirm shaft and
drive 200-230 V 1-ph, STO, RS-485 Modbus, 3 m motor + encoder cables
Agitator gearmotor 1/4 HP 115 V 1-ph, about 60 rpm, face-mount, output shaft Ø5/8 in keyed, 4 x 1/4-20 on Ø3.75 in
011-series parallel shaft 1/4 HP 60 rpm (confirm flange; head plate slots are 9
Auger tooling, 2 sets to drawing P1-401-600: S (shaker) 27 OD auger + 1.25 in tube, J (jar/pouch/tub) 46 OD auger + 2 in
custom auger + funnel tube to P1-401-600 (quote with blend samples)
tube; 316, M16 x 1.5 LH top thread
Filler controls: CLICK PLUS PLC C2-03CPU-2 + 8 in / 8 out DC module + C-more Micro 3 in HMI
Foot switch, guarded, 1 NO + 1 NC, IP68, 3 m cord
Ball bearings: 2 x 6205-2RS (spindle), 2 x 6008-2RS (agitator hub), food-grade grease
Timing drive HTD 5M 15 wide: pulley 20T bore Ø19 key 6 (servo), pulley 40T bore Ø20 key 6 (spindle), belt 450-5M-15
Roller chain drive #40 stainless: sprocket 15T (bore 5/8 in key), sprocket 30T plate (bored Ø81 H7, 4 x Ø6.5 on Ø100),
40SS 15T B-hub + 40SS 30T A-plate (bore to drawing) + RS40-SS x 52L

Index plunger M16 x 1.5, pin Ø10, pull knob with rest position, stainless

22 mm operators: E-stop 40 mm mushroom 2 NC, blue reset 1 NO, green and red LED pilot lights 24 V
Coded magnetic safety switch 2 NC, M12 connector, IP69K, for the scoop flap
Disconnect switch 25 A 2-pole, lockable OFF, side-mount handle
Breakers and motor protection: F1 S202-C10 (servo drive), F2 S202-D8 (T1 primary), F3 S201-C8 (120 V), Q2 MS116-4.0 +
HKF1-11 (agitator), KM1 AF09-30-10-13 24 V DC coil
Power supply 24 V DC 2.5 A, DIN rail
